cues: Dicliny: separate male and female flowers, as in maize and papaya.
Heterostyly: different style lengths in different plants, as in Primula.
And self incompatibility, a genetic lock that stops a plant's own pollen from growing on its stigma.
text: And four more. Dicliny: separate male and female flowers, as in maize and papaya. Herkogamy: a physical barrier. Heterostyly: different style lengths in different plants, as in Primula. And self incompatibility, a genetic lock that stops a plant's own pollen from growing on its stigma.
